mod.gyk.modmanager.desc: Lists every installed mod with its name, description and enabled state. Toggle a mod here and restart the game to load or unload it.
mod.p1xel8ted.gyk.configurationmanager.d: In-game settings window for every mod. Press F1 to open it and change each mod's options without editing config files.
mod.p1xel8ted.gyk.addstraighttotable.des: Skips the "Are you sure?" confirmation when you pick a body part to remove at the autopsy table.
mod.p1xel8ted.gyk.alchemyresearchredux.d: Shows what an alchemy combination will produce before you craft it. Patches a gap where researched recipes weren't actually registered as known.
mod.p1xel8ted.gyk.appletreesenhanced.des: Turns garden apple trees, berry bushes, and bee hives into passive producers that drop harvests for you to pick up. Optional realistic mode.
mod.p1xel8ted.gyk.decompdelight.desc: Adds the decomposition element (Chaos/Life/Death/Body/Mind/Nature…) to every researched item's tooltip.
mod.p1xel8ted.gyk.fastercraftreloaded.de: Speed up every crafting-related activity. Each speedup is a separate toggle.
mod.p1xel8ted.gyk.ineedsticks.desc: Adds a "Wooden stick" craft to the circular saw, so you don't have to grind fallen branches.
mod.p1xel8ted.gyk.keeperscandles.desc: Candelabras and incense burners stay lit forever; removing a candle returns it to your inventory.
mod.p1xel8ted.gyk.moarwells.desc: Adds the basic stone well and the pump well to the wooden build desk. The pump well spawns on the nearest existing stone well and can be placed repeatedly; a config toggle removes its Engineer tech requirement.
mod.p1xel8ted.gyk.theseedequalizer.desc: Stops garden and vineyard seed counts from slowly bleeding dry - keeps at least a 1:1 ratio, usually net-positive.
mod.p1xel8ted.gyk.wheresmaveggies.desc: Harvest every ready garden plot of the same crop at once instead of walking to each bed.
mod.p1xel8ted.gyk.economyreloaded.desc: Disables vendor inflation and deflation so prices stay stable over a long playthrough.
mod.p1xel8ted.gyk.exhaustless.desc: QoL tweaks that reduce grind around energy, sanity, gratitude, tools, meditation, and sleep. All off by default or independently toggleable.
mod.p1xel8ted.gyk.givememoar.desc: Multipliers for just about every drop, reward, and craft output in the game.
mod.p1xel8ted.gyk.praythedayaway.desc: Lifts the vanilla "one sermon per week" rule and gives you fine-grained control over church running costs.
mod.p1xel8ted.gyk.wheresmapoints.desc: Red / green / blue XP goes straight to your bar instead of spawning physical orbs - big performance win when you've been crafting a lot.
mod.p1xel8ted.gyk.bringoutyerdead.desc: Control when and how fast the body-delivery donkey arrives at the graveyard. Multiple deliveries per day; faster walk.
mod.p1xel8ted.gyk.gravechangesredux.desc: Raises the max quality of grave items and decorations from the vanilla cap up to 30.
mod.p1xel8ted.gyk.ibuildwhereiwant.desc: Build anywhere on the map instead of only inside the pre-defined construction zones.
mod.p1xel8ted.gyk.longerdays.desc: Stretches the in-game day. Vanilla is 7.5 real-time minutes per day - double or triple it without changing anything else.
mod.p1xel8ted.gyk.notimeforfishing.desc: Skips the fishing mini-game. Cast your line and the mod handles the rest.
mod.p1xel8ted.gyk.regenerationreloaded.d: Passive life and energy regeneration at a rate you control - the keeper recovers over time without needing to sleep, eat, or meditate.
mod.p1xel8ted.gyk.treesnomore.desc: Once you've cleared a tree (felled + stump dug), nothing grows back there. Useful for laying out a graveyard or garden.
mod.p1xel8ted.gyk.fogbegone.desc: Cleans up the weather overlay. Fog removed by default; wind and rain stay unless you turn them off too.
mod.p1xel8ted.gyk.maxbuttonsredux.desc: Min/Max buttons on the craft window (queues as many as you can afford in one click) + Max button on vendor slider. Controller triggers snap to min/max. Requires Rest In Patches.
mod.p1xel8ted.gyk.miscbitsandbobs.desc: Grab-bag: movement-speed multiplier, Evict Church Visitors button, Skip Intro Video On New Game, Remove Cinematic Letterboxing, more. All toggleable.
mod.p1xel8ted.gyk.newgameatbottom.desc: Moves the "New Game" slot to the bottom of the save list so you don't fat-finger it.
mod.p1xel8ted.gyk.nointros.desc: Skips the publisher and developer logos on launch.
mod.p1xel8ted.gyk.queueeverything.desc: Turns the craft window into a proper queueing interface. Optional idle auto-crafts you can walk away from.
mod.p1xel8ted.gyk.restinpatches.desc: Collection of small vanilla bug fixes: restores missing craft-window arrow icons, smooths player movement, tunes footprints, keeps big stockpiles visible, swallows a few harmless vanilla exceptions. More added over time.
mod.p1xel8ted.gyk.savenow.desc: Save anytime with a keybind, auto-save on a timer, save on new day/on exit, restore your exact position on reload, tidier load-game list with pin-last-played.
mod.p1xel8ted.gyk.showmemoar.desc: Modern display support: native resolution, higher refresh rates, zoom, HUD scaling.
mod.p1xel8ted.gyk.thoughtfulreminders.de: When the day flips over, the keeper thinks about what day of the week it is and what's happening, so you don't walk past merchant days or tavern nights.
mod.p1xel8ted.gyk.deadgiveaway.desc: Shows each zombie's work efficiency in a label floating over its head, readable across the whole graveyard without inspecting bodies one at a time.
mod.p1xel8ted.gyk.autolootheavies.desc: Teleports heavy drops (timber, stone, marble, ore) straight to the nearest stockpile with space.
mod.p1xel8ted.gyk.beammeupgerryrewrite.d: Teleport stones become a fast-travel system to every zone you've visited. Zero cooldown, optional small fee, save your own custom teleport points.
mod.p1xel8ted.gyk.gerrysjunktrunk.desc: A buildable trunk Gerry empties at midnight - drop items in, get coin back at dawn. Upgrade it through Woodworking → Engineer → Jeweler tech.
mod.p1xel8ted.gyk.getouttamyway.desc: Walk through NPCs instead of pushing them around. No more body-blocks in doorways.
mod.p1xel8ted.gyk.moarpallets.desc: Adds wooden pallets to the wooden and cellar build desks. Cellar pallets get filled by the elevator and emptied by the porter; barn pallets count toward merchant trading capacity. Loose crates auto-route to the nearest pallet with space.
mod.p1xel8ted.gyk.wheresmastorage.desc: One shared inventory across every crafting station, bigger chests, bigger stacks. Important: don't mix with other inventory-modifying mods.
